title: Synthetic demo: CRISPR screen for CAR-T persistence
proposal: A CRISPR knockout screen will identify genes that improve the persistence rate of CAR-T cells versus standard CAR-T therapy in adult patients.

prior_art.title: CRISPR knockout screens in CAR-T cells
prior_art.abstract: Synthetic demonstration record: CRISPR knockout screens identified regulators of the CAR-T persistence rate in primary T cells. Persistence improved in the screened arm.

prior_art.title: CAR-T persistence without genetic screening
prior_art.abstract: Synthetic demonstration record: standard CAR-T therapy showed no significant improvement in the persistence rate compared with the control cohort.

resources.data: primary T cells from consented donors
resources.ethics: IRB approved for the synthetic demo
